title: IMAX The End of Oak Street

title_lang.en: IMAX The End of Oak Street

synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

synopsis_lang.en: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.
synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
《末世凶煞》懸疑賣座鬼才 J.J. Abrams 監製主理，全新科幻災劫新作《末世橡樹街》(The End of Oak Street)，將於暑假壓軸驚震大銀幕！華納兄弟呈獻，大衛羅伯特米切爾自編自導，《穿Prada的惡魔2》超人氣天后安妮夏菲維，聯同《迷幻列車》影帝伊雲麥葵格兩大巨星首度聯手，上演幕幕刺激滿分、意想不到的絕境逃難求生記！

 

一場詭異宇宙災變，瞬間把郊區橡樹街從地圖上抹去——居民家園連根拔起，整個社區墮入無名之地！前路未明，「龍」跡處處，危機四伏，Platt夫婦（安妮夏菲維 及 伊雲麥葵格）帶著孩子們驚覺到，要活著的唯一依靠⋯⋯就是彼此！

cast: Anne Hathaway, Ewan McGregor, Maisy Stella, Christian Convery
